name: Lyzerium Bottles

source.title: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg

disable: Interact action to pick up one of the five bottles.

items.name: Explode
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps on the bottle or the bottle becomes broken

---

Effect The bottle explodes, dealing 2d8 fire damage plus 2 persistent fire damage and 2 fire splash damage to each creature sharing its square (DC 18 basic Reflex save).

text: Five tiny glass bottles, each full of volatile green liquid, are discretely positioned around the room. Each bottle explodes when its glass is broken.
